Consider a circle with radius $3$ centered at the point $(3,0),$ shown above.

Earlier part 1:

Write the equation of this circle in the form $(x-a)^{2}+(y-b)^{2}={r}^{2}.$

                            
                                    
                                        
                                            

                                                

                                        
                                        
                                        

                                    
                                
                                    
                            
                                        $(x-3)^2+(y-0)^2=9$

                                        $\sqrt{9-(x-3)^2}$

                                        $-\sqrt{9-(x-3)^2}$
